newsitem.title: CROATIA: Zagrebacka Banka to release '96 results April 8.
newsitem.headline: Zagrebacka Banka to release '96 results April 8.

text.p: Fully-listed Croatian bank Zagrebacka Banka said on Thursday it would release its 1996 business results on April 8.
It had a group net loss of 184 million kuna in 1995 due to losses of the bank's tourist industry subsidiaries, despite a 124 million kuna parent profit.
But the group made a pre-tax profit of 107 million kuna in the first half of last year, compared to a 117 million kuna loss in the comparable period of 1995.
At a news conference the bank's president Franjo Lukovic will also announce its credit rating, Zagrebacka said in a press release.
The bank had applied to three leading agencies -- International Bank Rating Agency (IBCA), Moody's, Standard & Poor's, and said it hoped for a rating in a BBB range.
For the moment it is the only financial institution in Croatia listed on London's Seaq International, where its 1/10 global depositary receipts traded at $30.8-$31 earlier Thursday.
